final: WITH timing_means AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), overall AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals) SELECT AVG(t.avg_ownership) AS mean_of_above_average_timings, AVG(t.avg_ownership - o.overall_avg) AS mean_amount_above_average FROM timing_means t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_ownership > o.overall_avg
